scope.evidence: Diff touches only .env.example, CHANGELOG.md, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/logging.md, phpunit.xml and tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php, all of which serve the task; the extra DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL="" pin in phpunit.xml is directly related to testing the notifier.

issues.explanation: The two tests named 'without url' only assert that Log::error was called once, so the security-critical requirement that neither the log message nor its context contains the webhook URL is not actually verified.

Text building happens before the try block and the non-2xx Log::error at :25 is unguarded, so a non-stringable context value or a throwing logger can still propagate, which contradicts the 'never throw / never break the caller' requirement.
No test covers the audit logging lane or the new logging config (e.g. Log::channel('audit')->info(...)), leaving the logging-channel requirement unverified by the suite.
The public send() method has no PHPDoc, while the project convention asks for PHPDoc on public methods touched by a change.
The success test reads $request['content'] but never asserts the request body is sent as JSON (content type/body), so requirement 3's 'POST a JSON body' is not explicitly verified.

review.summary: Adds the App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert notifier with truncation, recursive redaction and soft-fail logging, plus the archive/audit logging lanes, env/phpunit config, docs and Pest coverage. The change is lean, in scope and handles secret redaction and URL scrubbing correctly, but the URL-absence assertions and audit-channel/config behavior are untested and the no-throw guarantee is not enforced around text building and the non-2xx log call; the daily-channel retention could not be verified from the diff. These are minor test/robustness nits, so the PR is approvable with small follow-ups.
